verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs describe off-cycle payrolls for paying outside the regular schedule, covering one-off corrections and special bonuses. A dedicated create-off-cycle-payroll guide documents bonus-specific tax and deduction handling via off_cycle_reason, and the platform overview lists off-cycle payments and termination processing. missing for 10: explicit documentation of an off-cycle payroll run specifically for terminations (only listed alongside off-cycle as 'termination processing'), independent or hands-on corroboration of off-cycle runs.
